items.review: Individually inspected source-served 1800 x 1347 PAA panel: visible black hat, red robe, crane badge, title 史忠正公讚像 and 李世倬敬摹 signature. No modern reenactment, generated content or scene mismatch. Mount and calibration strip retained.

targetEvidence.review: Full assembled bilingual record read. Defense and death after city fell supported by the Palace Museum; inherited solitary-army phrasing is rhetorical, not a verified troop count. No new quantified or heroic claims added.

connection.en: This later likeness commemorates the named defender of Yangzhou in 1645. The same scroll includes a family letter describing the siege, but the selected image is the portrait section. Neither the portrait nor its laudatory title is an eyewitness record of the fighting.
connection.zh: 这幅后世肖像纪念1645年扬州守将史可法。同卷还收有描述围城的家书，但所选图像是肖像部分。画面及其颂扬性题名均非战斗现场实录。

title.en: Shi Kefa remembered after the fall of Yangzhou
title.zh: 扬州城破之后的史可法纪念像

alt.en: A bearded official wears a black court hat and red robe with a crane rank badge; an inscription names Shi Zhongzheng and the painter Li Shizhuo.
alt.zh: 一位蓄须官员戴黑色官帽，穿饰仙鹤补子的红袍；题字标明史忠正公与画家李世倬。

caption.en: Portrait of Shi Kefa by Li Shizhuo, catalogued as a Qing-dynasty work. The painter signs it as a respectful copy. Its date is not specified by the museum; 1645 dates the Yangzhou defense and Shi’s death, not this painting. The scroll also carries later inscriptions, including one dated 1779.
caption.zh: 李世倬所绘史可法像，馆方归于清代，作者署“敬摹”。馆方未给出画幅的确切创作年；1645年是扬州守城与史氏去世的年份，并非此画年代。同卷还有后世题跋，包括1779年的一则。

interpretation.en: This later likeness commemorates the named defender of Yangzhou in 1645. The same scroll includes a family letter describing the siege, but the selected image is the portrait section. Neither the portrait nor its laudatory title is an eyewitness record of the fighting.
interpretation.zh: 这幅后世肖像纪念1645年扬州守将史可法。同卷还收有描述围城的家书，但所选图像是肖像部分。画面及其颂扬性题名均非战斗现场实录。

chronologyNotes.finding: Core 1645 Yangzhou defense and death supported by Palace Museum. Do not derive precise death circumstances or troop totals from this portrait.

Do not use text date 1644 as painting date. Transcribed colophon has sexagenary/conversion inconsistencies (壬辰 labelled1773; 道光十年 labelled1836 while full text says十六年). Caption cites only unambiguous1779 colophon and undated Qing portrait; no target correction based on inconsistent conversions.

ownerReview: Portrait panel individually viewed; title, painter signature, crane badge and retained calibration strip verified. Painting remains undated Qing, not the event date1645 or text date1644. Unrelated personal calligraphy excluded.
